gates.evidence_source: No consent record or approval was found in the checked-out repository.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Obtain and provenance-record consent from an identifiable creator or authorized team before enrollment.

gates.requirement: Authority to observe the clipping/publication workflow
gates.evidence_source: No observation-authority grant was found in the checked-out repository.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Identify the workflow owner and obtain an auditable grant of observation authority; consent alone is insufficient.

gates.requirement: Durable access to source livestream recordings
gates.evidence_source: No real recording, durable access grant, retention commitment, or source owner was found.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Demonstrate authorized, durable recording access and identify its owner and retention surface.

gates.evidence_source: The protocol requires source timecodes, but no real source-timecode surface or owner was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Demonstrate durable authorized access to timecodes that map candidate frames to the recording start.

gates.requirement: Prospective workflow capture through audit logs, interaction logs, or protocol-compliant stopwatch capture
gates.evidence_source: The protocol and schema represent acceptable capture types; no real workflow capture surface, operator, or access was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Select and verify at least one authorized prospective capture method with an identifiable owner.

gates.evidence_source: No destination account, audit/API evidence surface, access grant, or owner was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Demonstrate authorized access to immutable evidence of the destination source-system publication time.

gates.requirement: Evidence that publication became publicly retrievable
gates.evidence_source: The protocol defines publication as destination success plus public retrievability; no authorized prospective evidence source was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Define and verify a provenance-capable prospective check of first public retrievability.

gates.evidence_source: The schema has a storage URI field, but no immutable storage service, retention policy, access owner, or test artifact was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Provision and verify an immutable artifact store with an identifiable responsible owner and adequate retention.

gates.requirement: Ability to calculate and store SHA-256 identities for provenance artifacts
gates.evidence_source: Repository validation calculates protocol-file SHA-256 and the schema can represent digests, but no real provenance artifact hashing/storage path was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Verify the actual collector-to-immutable-store path calculates and preserves each real artifact digest; representation and synthetic fixtures do not satisfy this gate.

gates.requirement: Source-clock/offset capture sufficient for frozen timestamp semantics
gates.evidence_source: The protocol and schema require clock source/offset metadata, but no real source clock or offset capture was demonstrated.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Verify source clocks, raw timestamps, timezones, resolutions, and NTP offsets or explicit unknown values for every selected source.

gates.requirement: Identifiable data owner/responsible source for every required evidence surface
gates.evidence_source: No real-world data owner or responsible source is identified for any required evidence surface.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: Identify and provenance-record the responsible owner/source for consent, authority, recording, timecode, workflow, destination, clock, and storage surfaces.

gates.evidence_source: No access was demonstrated; Issue 5 permits omission of value analysis when fixed-window views are unavailable or noncomparable, and this assessment omits it.
gates.unresolved_dependency_or_blocker: None for base collection readiness. Value analysis remains omitted unless this gate is later satisfied before collection without changing the frozen protocol.
